title: LTC Funding Comparator
description: Long-term-care funding arithmetic over caller-declared inputs: simple sums of a declared self-fund annual set-aside and a declared traditional annual premium over a declared horizon, alongside a declared hybrid lump premium, with a CHEAPEST_IDENTIFIED or TIE_IDENTIFIED verdict and a full trace. On the tie path the page reports that no unique cheapest exists. Absent or invalid inputs fail closed and are named. Rounding is 2dp half-up. Arithmetic only: not insurance advice. No network, no storage, no clock.

horizon_years.description: Declared comparison horizon in years, integer in [1, 100].

self_fund_annual.description: Declared annual self-fund set-aside in currency units, number in [0, 1000000000].

hybrid_premium_total.description: Declared hybrid premium lump total in currency units, number in [0, 1000000000].

traditional_annual.description: Declared traditional annual premium in currency units, number in [0, 1000000000].
